name: Tweetbot sandbox apns-auth
description: QA-001 notification-service only; numeric aggregate without notification contents

selectors: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM logs.workersLogs WHERE accountTag = '1657a0cfdeed30e3504b6f86cd9575e8' AND scriptName = 'notification-service' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE AND attributes['event'] = 'apns_response' AND attributes['status'] = 403

name: Tweetbot sandbox http-5xx
